diceBuilder.title: Dice Assembly Simulator
diceBuilder.hint: Convex fixed: Grass/Fire/Water/Lightning/Steel — Concave fixed: Dark/Fighting/Psychic/Flying. Round sockets hold single-type chips, square sockets hold two-tone chips.
diceBuilder.rollingHint: Press and shake the dice, then let go to throw!
diceBuilder.quickApplyHint: Pick one energy type to fill Dice 1-3's round and square sockets. If it's a convex-pool type, the convex face gets it too (concave stays); if it's a concave-pool type, the concave face gets it too (convex stays)
diceBuilder.probHint: All 3 dice rolled together, tallied by the resulting energy-type combo (sorted by odds)

moveOdds.title: Move Odds
moveOdds.hint: Pick a Pokémon to see how often the current dice build can pay each move's cost. Character-die odds include the move landing first.

picker.dualHint: Pick an energy type for each half

pokemonCenter.text: You stop by a Pokémon Center, where a kind {name} gives you an apple.

berryBush.text: You find a berry bush by the road, and {name} shows you which ones are safe to eat.

oldMaster.text: A mysterious trainer, {name}, teaches you some battle tricks.

hotSpring.text: You soak in a hot spring together — {name} relaxes right beside you.

ironWill.text: Watching {name} stand firm in battle gives you newfound confidence.

treasureChest.text: You find a treasure chest containing training gear left behind by {name}.
treasureChest.effect: Max HP permanently +15, and heals the same amount.

windyHill.text: Up on a windswept hill, you train alongside {name}.

rainyDay.text: On a rainy day, {name} teaches you how to shield your allies.

campfireSong.text: {name} sings by the campfire, and it puts your mind at ease.

secretTraining.text: You join {name} for a secret training session.
secretTraining.effect: Max HP permanently +10, and heals the same amount.

campfire.title: Campfire
campfire.description: You find a campfire and take a moment to rest.

boss.reward: Boss defeated! Learn a new move and gain +1 energy die.

victory.title: All 3 Acts Cleared!
victory.subtitle: You've reached the top of the tower.
